name: online-writing
description: A suite of skills for online writing based on 'The Art and Business of Online Writing.' Covers the full pipeline: discovering your writing purpose, content buckets, and voice tonality, ideating and exploring post topics, structuring short-form posts (800-1,200 words), Medium-ready articles, and long-form drafts (2,500-3,000 words), improving existing drafts, running structural diagnostics, rating content quality (VPM, dimensions, goals), distilling long-form into platform micro-posts, generating single-paragraph article abstracts, and producing Midjourney prompts for companion imagery.

interface.shortDescription: Writing skills for ideation, drafting, and editing
interface.longDescription: A bundled set of writing skills for purpose discovery, ideation, drafting, rewriting, diagnostics, scoring, and repurposing posts.
defaultPrompt: Help me find sharper angles for my next post.
Turn these notes into a publishable article draft.
Diagnose why this draft still feels weak.
